From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Book of Business deep-dive prep for leadership deck

Team —

Leadership asked me to pull a concise "book of business" deep-dive for the upcoming deck (leadership review next Tue). I want account-by-account one-pagers for the top 12 opportunities by ARR where we think the decision window is within 90 days. Please use the attached BoB_onepager_template.xlsx and populate the following columns: Account name, Redwood rep, ARR / ACV, current stage, expected close (month), probability (70/50/30 style), blockers (security/procurement/usage), next step owner and date, ask for leadership (credit/exec intro/exec time).

Deliverable: PDFs of each one-pager + a consolidated CSV for forecast stitching (see sample columns in template). Deadline: EOD Friday 3/19 so I can fold into the deck on Monday.

Quick notes:
- Flag any account that needs a security/compliance deep-dive (we'll loop SRE/Trust).
- If you have >1 owner on an account, please pick a single point-of-contact for the one-pager.

I attached the template and a HubSpot link for the priority list (sorted by ARR). Call out any accounts you need me to own.

Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: [BoB_onepager_template.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Book of Business deep-dive prep for leadership deck

Alex —

Thanks for the ask. I'm taking point on NexaHealth (RDW-8472), HelioMed, and Atla Systems. Attached is a draft PDF for NexaHealth — pulled in usage trends and our GAAPI P50 latency numbers that leadership has asked for. Key callouts:

- NexaHealth: strong PoC results, procurement timeline looks 30–45 days but they asked for an SOC2 snippet and a short runbook for on-prem deployment (flagged security).
- HelioMed: stalled on budget signoff; finance needs an exec sponsor to expedite (ask: 1-hour exec intro).
- Atla Systems: legal redline in progress, expected close late Q3.

Question on probability: do you want probability calibrated to our internal win-score or leadership-facing bands (70/40/10)? I used 60% for Nexa per our internal rubric but can shift to a leadership-friendly 70.

I'll upload the other two one-pagers by EOD Friday.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: [NexaHealth_summary_Mar18.pdf (pdf, 72KB)]
